name: AQ Wiring Systems NY
old_description: Custom electrical wire harnesses, battery cables, control panels, electromechanical enclosures
about:
AQ Wiring Systems NY operates from Plattsburgh, New York. The business traces its roots to 1991 and became part of the Swedish multinational AQ Group in 2018 through the acquisition of B3CG Interconnect, a longtime connectivity specialist. The Plattsburgh location serves as one of nine wiring-systems factories across eight countries within the AQ Group network.

The company produces custom electrical wire harnesses, battery cables, control panels, high‑voltage cables, and electromechanical enclosures. Its engineering team offers VAVE analysis, design assistance, lean‑manufacturing optimization, and prototyping with PPAP and FAI processes. All output undergoes 100 % testing and traceability certification. In addition to the Plattsburgh plant, AQ Wiring Systems runs a 45,000‑square‑foot facility in Tultitlan, Mexico, staffed by 350 craftsmen, and a site in Saint‑Eustache, Quebec, enabling both high‑mix/low‑volume and low‑mix/high‑volume production.

Customers span transportation, industrial, medical, and recreational sectors. The firm positions itself as an electrical‑connectivity expert for demanding OEMs and tier‑one suppliers who require turnkey project management and global procurement leverage.

AQ Wiring Systems NY emphasizes its integration into the AQ Group’s global supply chain, which provides international purchasing power, consolidated best practices, and access to low‑cost manufacturing partners. This structure allows competitive pricing while maintaining quality through standardized processes across its multi‑country footprint.
